paper.title_en: Numerical studies on avalanche to streamer transition in THGEM-based particle detectors
paper.abstract_en: Gaseous ionization detectors are usually operated in the avalanche mode. The necessity of higher gain sometimes pushes them close to the streamer regime. Streamers are known to induce response instabilities and non-uniformity in the short term, while enhanced aging, or even irreparable damage can occur due to prolonged streamer mode operation. As a result, it is important to understand the dynamics of avalanche to streamer transition. This necessity has motivated us to carry out a numerical study focusing on the transition dynamics in THGEMs, and structures derived from the THGEM (such as the THWELL), using a particle–fluid hybrid simulation model. In particular, the importance of electric field distortion due to space charge accumulation, and its role in determining the transition from avalanche to streamer, has been clearly demonstrated by our studies. •Study avalanche to streamer transition in THGEM-based devices using a fluid model.•Illustration of space-charge effect resulting into severe electric field distortion.•Study the role of space-charge accumulation in determining the transition region.
